outcome: Agreement between self-reported reasons for cesarean delivery and hospital discharge records
Positive predictive value (PPV) of self-reported reasons
cohort: 846 women who gave birth to their first baby by cesarean delivery between 2009 and 2011, part of the First Baby Study
finding: Over 90% of women accurately recalled at least one reason for their cesarean delivery when compared to hospital records, although the accuracy varied by specific reason.
